definitions.short: to rend , literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them)
definitions.full: H7167. qara קָרַע 63 verb tear (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic strike head, bell, etc., beat drum, box ear, gnash teeth (Frey Dozy); also impugn, censure ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ק 1Sam 15:28 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular זַיִּקְרַע Gen 37:29 +; 1 singular suffix אֶקְרָעֶנָּה 1Kin 11:12 , etc.; Imperative masculine plural קִרְעוּ 2Sam 3:31 ; Joel 2:13 ; Infinitive absolute קָרֹעַ 1Kin 11:11 ; construct לִקְרוֺעַ Eccl 3:7 , suffix קָרְעִי Ezra 9:5 ; Participle active קֹרֵעַ 1Kin 11:31 ; passive קָרוּעַ 2Sam 15:32 , etc.; — tear, rend: 1. a. usually (39 t.) of rending garment in (I) sign of grief, distress: בֶּגֶד (29 t.) Gen 37:29 , 34 ; 44:13 ; 2Sam 13:19 +; ׳ק ׳ב קְרָעִים לִשְׁנַיִם 2Kin 2:12 , ׳ק ב וְאַל ׳לְבַבְכֶם Joel 2:13 ; participle Pass. ק ׳בְּגָדָיו 2Sam 1:2 ; construct ב ׳קְרֻעֵי torn of garments (pers. with torn garments 13:31 (but read ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ב ׳קָֽרְעוּ Th We and others), 2Kin 18:37 = Isa 36:22 ; Jer 41:5 ; מְעִיל Job 1:20 ; 2:12 ; Ezra 9:3 (+ בֶּנֶד ), כְּתֹנֶת 2Sam 13:19 , כֻּתָּנְתּוֺ קָרוּעַ 15:32 (Ges § 121d ); שְׂמָתֹ Gen 37:34 ; 44:13 ; Josh 7:6 ; passive participle קְרֻעִים מַדָּיו 1Sam 4:12 ; (2) as symbolic act, ק ׳קְרָעִים עָשָׁר שְׁנֵים שַׂלְמָה 1Kin 11:30 ; (3) absolute לִתְמּוֺר וְעֵת לִקְרוֺעַ עֵת Eccl 3:7 . b. tear away or out: veils Ezek 13:21 , fillets from ( מֵעַל ) arms 13:20 , mark of leprosy out of ( מִן ) garment Lev 13:56 . 2 tear away sovereignty (under figure of garment), subject מֵעַל ׳י, person 1Sam 15:28 ; 1Kin 11:11 , also מִיַּד 1Sam 28:17 ; 1Kin 11:12 , 31 , מִן 14:8 , absolute 11:13 ; with accusative ׳יִשׂ + מֵעַל 2Kin 17:21 . 3 tear, rend asunder: a. book with ( ב ) knife Jer 36:23 . b. = make wide, large , eyes, with ( ב ) stibium Jer 4:30 ; windows, ׳וק לוֺ [ ו ] חַלּוֺנָ֑י 22:14 . c. rend open heavens, and descend of ׳י , Isa 63:19 . 4 tear, rend , of wild beasts: ׳י as fierce bear Hosea 13:8 (object לִבָּם סְגוֺר ); figurative of human foes Psa 35:15 (accusative of person omitted), so Hup and others, but (from context) Ol Bae We and others malign, rail (compare Arabic above); > Gr and others קָרְאוֺ .
